services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: As the sun bids adieu, hop aboard the Emita II and cruise away from Michigan City into a glorious sunset! Every night, our top deck will have live entertainment that’ll make you want to dance like no one’s watching. With our freshly spruced up main deck and those lovely open-air windows, you can soak in the lake’s breathtaking views while sipping on your favorite drinks from our full bar. Cheers to that! Starting Monday Aug 18th Cruise times will be adjusted to 6:30 pm - 8:00pm (central standard time)due to the sun setting earlier. services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: Lake Michigan and Trail Creek are absolutely beautiful, and what better way to enjoy them than by kayak or paddleboard? Come paddle the Lake Michigan shoreline at one of the regions best beaches or explore the peaceful flowing water of Trail Creek. The Perception Tribe series of sit-on-top kayaks are defined by their ultra-stable, yet quick and playful performance. Tribe kayak’s versatile design makes it a top choice for beginner to intermediate paddlers. The entire family will appreciate how easy it is to get on and off this stable sit-on-top. services.name: Waverunner Rentals
services.desc: As the leaders of WaveRunner rentals in Michigan City, we are committed to offering only the latest, most innovative equipment from Yamaha. By continuously updating our fleet, we ensure that our customers enjoy a safe and high-performance ride every time. So, why wait? Whether you’re on vacation or a local looking for a thrilling experience, Harbor Country Adventures is the place to be. Book your WaveRunner rental today and make the most of your time on Lake Michigan! Our Main Dock is located at Millennium Plaza along Trail Creek. blurb: Harbor Country Adventures offers a variety of activities including chill cruises, wild rides on the Searocket boat, solo paddle rentals, and luxury motor coach rentals for touring local wineries and distilleries. Located near Indiana Dunes National Park, it provides options for thrill-seekers and those looking for a laid-back experience.

quotes.author: Terry Wright
quotes.text: The boat excursion was very fun. The Captain was very informative about the lake and Indiana Dunes National Park. We definitely would come back and do it again!

quotes.author: Christa Reichardt
quotes.text: We had a wonderful time on the boat tour. Everyone was knowledgeable, professional, and courteous. It was relaxing and informative. I would highly recommend.

quotes.author: Liz Dahm
quotes.text: We had a blast on the boat celebrating Emily's birthday! This was our second time with you and both were exceptional! Definitely recommend!!

quotes.author: Katie Garibaldi
quotes.text: We had a great time, though the DJ needs to work on his emcee skills. Weird comments especially towards women and he had no shame.
